---
title: "Data Dictionary"
output: html_notebook
---
Species - Species name of each observation
F_BC_MEAN - Mean blood cortisol concentration of Female individuals evaluated in this study. Reported in nanograms per milliliters
M_BC_MEAN - Mean blood cortisol concentration of Male individuals evaluated in this study. Reported in nanograms per milliliters
Common_name - Common name of each observed species
F_BC_N - Number of Female subjects that had their blood cortisol levels measured.
M_BC_N - Number of Male subjects that had their blood cortisol levels measured.
Genus - Genus name of each observation
Elevation - Elevation in meters where observations were taken of each individual
Combined_BC_Mean - Baseline Cortisol levels observed in subjects in nanograms per milliliter of blood
GenSpec - Genus and species name of each observation separated by "_".
logCort - log transformed values of baseline blood cortisol in nanograms per milliliter (ng/mL) for each observation
tree - Phylogenetic tree built with rotl package based on species present in dataset
pglmmModellog - Phylogenetic generalized linear mixed model based on the linear relationship of blood cortisol concentration relative to elevation.
